insight: Went public on the NYSE in 2023 (~$9B valuation); Shopify holds ~11% after a $100M investment in 2022.
name: Klaviyo
tagline: Email + SMS marketing automation with AI segmentation, predictions, and agents.
description: Klaviyo is a marketing automation platform for email, SMS, and push, built on a unified customer database. Its AI layer powers predictive analytics (lifetime value, churn risk, next-order timing), AI segmentation, automated A/B testing, and newer agentic features (Composer and Customer Agent). It is especially dominant in ecommerce, with deep Shopify integration.
edge: The ecommerce default: AI predictions (CLV, churn) on a unified customer database, with the deepest Shopify integration among SMS/email platforms.
cons: Costs climb fast with list size
AI is part of a broader suite
